hypotheses.binder: (hM : ∀ t x, D.M.field t (-x) = D.M.field t x)
hypotheses.justification: The theorem needs the frame derivative to be even, but this follows from hF without assuming hM: differentiate the equality D.F.field t (-x) = D.F.field t x in time, using D.frame_time to identify the derivatives with D.F₁.field t (-x) and D.F₁.field t x. Applying the coefficient definition then gives evenness of D.frameDerivative. That replaces the use of D.frameDerivative_even hF hM in the proof. The other parity inputs hSym, hraw, and hinit are not supplied by this argument.
